data.heading: Oceans, seas, and rivers
data.text: Oceans, seas, and rivers are home to many types of plants and animals.
Some animals live in water some of the time, and on land the rest of the time.
Some water habitats like seas and oceans have salt water.
Some water habitats like rivers and streams have fresh water.
Most fish can either live in salt water or in fresh water.
Humans can only drink fresh water.
